info.title: IFTTT Webhooks
info.description: NyxID adapter for preconfigured Webhooks Applets. Paths omit the secret suffix; NyxID injects the encrypted per-user key at egress. IFTTT Pro or Pro+ required. No Applet authoring or completion polling.

servers.description: IFTTT Webhooks, using NyxID credential-free adapter paths

post.description: Trigger an enabled IFTTT Applet configured with Receive a web request. For MCP, supply optional body: {value1, value2, value3} with string ingredients; omit body for an event without ingredients. Event names contain only ASCII letters, numbers, and underscores. Side effects depend on the Applet; more than one Applet may match. Accepted means event receipt, not completion. No idempotency guarantee; check IFTTT Activity before retrying an uncertain call.

x-aevatar-tool.description: Trigger an enabled IFTTT Applet configured with Receive a web request. For MCP, supply optional body: {value1, value2, value3} with string ingredients; omit body for an event without ingredients. Event names contain only ASCII letters, numbers, and underscores. Side effects depend on the Applet; more than one Applet may match. Accepted means event receipt, not completion. No idempotency guarantee; check IFTTT Activity before retrying an uncertain call.

parameters.name: event
parameters.description: The configured IFTTT event name: ASCII letters, numbers, and underscores only. Case-sensitive. Do not include a URL or key.

200.description: Sanitized NyxID receipt for IFTTT acceptance; not Applet completion.

accepted.description: True only when IFTTT returned 2xx; does not confirm an Applet exists or completed.

default.description: Sanitized NyxID receipt on upstream rejection; validation and transport failures use NyxID errors. Redirects return 502 with the upstream status.
